At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 
 AI/ML Data Engineering Specialist, US Commercial 

 As part of our enterprise AI strategy to speed life-changing therapies to patients, we are seeking an AI/ML Data Engineering Specialist to intersect US Commercial operations and AI transformation. This position will build deep understanding of finance processes and data and consult on tailored AI-enabled solutions for business needs. You will partner with US Commercial Product Owners, Solution Architects and Technical Delivery Leads to ensure solutions are accurate, optimized and deliver measurable impact through rigorous testing and experimentation. Reporting to the Director, Data & AI (US Commercial), the successful candidate will manage portfolio tracking and metrics across Commercial AI/ML initiatives while serving as an authoritative domain expert for Commercial Data & AI technical teams.
  
 **This position is based in Raleigh, NC (hybrid-eligible). 
  
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and execute prompt, context and harness engineering strategies and conduct experimentation to optimize AI model performance
 Lead process discovery across Commercial functions and translate business logic into technical specifications for data science and AI solutions
 Serve as Commercial SME in ML and AI model design, feature engineering, and solution architecture
 Document current-state workflows and design future-state AI-enabled processes
 Validate AI solutions against current-state workflows and regulatory requirements
 Contribute to the development of data solutions and provide post-implementation support including troubleshooting and root cause analysis
 Manage portfolio-level tracking, executive dashboards, and metrics across US Commercial AI/ML use cases
  
 Skills and Experiences 
 Bachelor’s or higher degree in statistics, data science and/or computer science and 5+ years of relevant experience
 Experience with ML, AI prompt engineering, LLM testing, or AI model experimentation
 Exposure to Commercial activities processes in a corporate environment a plus
 Good systems thinking ability – seeing connections and patterns and able to visualize workflows and processes. Experience or education on process design preferred.
 Able to visually depict activity in a process flow and identify opportunities to optimize processes using automation and AI
 Curious and agile learner across multiple domains
 Strong problem definition and problem solving skills
 Able to multitask, prioritize and manage projects across vendor teams
 Strong oral and written communication skills
  
 
 
The salary range for this position is: $94,690.00 - $122,540.00. Gilead considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package. Benefits include company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans*. 
 For additional benefits information, visit: 
 https://www.gilead.com/careers/compensation-benefits-and-wellbeing
